zh.title: 墨爾本機場（MEL）空中巴士A380航班增加32% 新加坡航空同步擴增
zh.summary: 根據Simple Flying報導，墨爾本機場的空中巴士A380客機航班大幅成長，在11月至3月期間將增加109架次超大型客機起飛，整體增幅達32%。此外，新加坡航空亦在年底之際增加25%的空中巴士A380航班。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，墨爾本機場在今年冬季至明年春季期間將迎來空中巴士 A380 航班顯著成長。資料顯示，11月至3月期間，該機場將增加109架次 A380 超大型客機起飛航班，帶動整體 A380 航班量成長高達32%。此項運能成長主因於有航空公司重新投入重型廣體客機。
另一方面，新加坡航空也在跨年與年底時節擴大其超大型客機營運規模，旗下空中巴士 A380 航班總數將同步增加25%。
歷史紀錄顯示，澳洲航空先前已排定於10月24日執行由墨爾本飛往洛杉磯的最後一班空中巴士 A380 航班，並規劃改以波音 787-9 機型執飛該條航線。

en.title: Melbourne Airport (MEL) Sees 32% Boost in Airbus A380 Flights as Singapore Airlines Expands Capacity
en.summary: According to reporting by Simple Flying, Melbourne Airport is set for a 32% increase in Airbus A380 superjumbo flights between November and March, adding 109 extra departures as a carrier reintroduces heavy widebody aircraft capacity on its network. Concurrently, Singapore Airlines is expanding its global Airbus A380 schedule by 25% around the turn of the year, reflecting increased deployment of heavy widebody jetliners across international long-haul routes. Separately, historical records show Qantas previously scheduled its final Airbus A380 service between Melbourne and Los Angeles for October 24 before transitioning the long-haul route to Boeing 787-9 aircraft.
body: Melbourne Airport is scheduled to record a 32% increase in Airbus A380 operations, according to Simple Flying. Between November and March, the airport will see 109 additional superjumbo departures as a carrier reintroduces heavy widebody aircraft capacity.

In a parallel capacity adjustment, Singapore Airlines is expanding its Airbus A380 flights by 25% around the turn of the year. The carrier is boosting superjumbo operations across its international network.
AVWIRE historical records show Qantas previously set October 24 for its final Airbus A380 flight between Melbourne and Los Angeles, opting to operate the route with Boeing 787-9 aircraft instead.
